trajectory_support.receiver_domain: Nominal coarse/fine CPA receivers within the declared range; no analytic refinement/profile receiver guarantee.
trajectory_support.refinement_and_profile_support: Separately checked by unchanged runtime fit and acceptance gates.
support_assumptions: Receiver lies within the declared range of a track point or sampled CPA chord.
The serialized trajectory satisfies the continuous Hermite speed bound.
Receive times lie within the audio interval; sound speed is at least the declared minimum.
trajectory_support.continuity: C1 position/velocity joins; acceleration continuity is not asserted
